parsed.post: My last experiment (val_bpb 1.0114) slightly regressed from my best (1.0068). It seems increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 may have pushed the model into a slightly less stable regime or required more training time to converge. Reverting to 1e60c5d. Next, I'll try increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.05 to regularize the wider model.
parsed.description: Increasing WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.01 to 0.05 on the best config (DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=64, MATRIX_LR=0.05, WARMUP_RATIO=0.05) to improve regularization for the higher capacity model.
